transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, honestly, what finally pushed me to make an appointment is just this constant tension. My shoulders and my neck... they just stay clenched all day long. It feels like I'm constantly bracing for a classroom observation that never actually ends. And by the time evening rolls around, my jaw aches so badly I can hardly even enjoy playing my guitar anymore. I just can't seem to physically relax.
Along with this physical tension, do you find yourself constantly worrying about many different everyday things?

Yeah, I do. It's like my mind just keeps circling all day. I'll start worrying about whether I'll ever get hired again, and then I'm stressing over whether I've completely ruined my reputation with the parents. Um, then I start thinking about how my retirement is just slipping away from me. 

It even happens with the little things... like, I'll worry that making a small mistake during a story-time activity means I just shouldn't be trusted with children anymore. So, yes, it's just a constant stream of worrying about almost everything.
How long have you been experiencing this constant worry and physical tension?
It's been going on for about a year and two months now. Um, basically ever since I was fired from the preschool. That's when all of this really started.
When you start worrying like that, do you find it difficult to control or stop the worry?

Yes, it's very difficult. I mean, I really try to stop it. I'll tell myself to just sit down and make a list, or I'll try to pray, or go out and weed the garden... just trying to focus on the next practical step, you know? But it doesn't work. One worry just hands off to another, and before I know it, I've lost half the afternoon just sitting there, completely caught up in it.
How has your sleep been during this past year?

My sleep has been pretty terrible, honestly. Most nights, I just lie in bed for hours. My mind is busy replaying answers I gave in past interviews, worrying about the bills, or thinking about licensing forms... it just won't shut off. And then, even when I finally manage to get some sleep, I usually wake up around four in the morning. And as soon as I'm awake, I'm already tense, just... calculating everything that could possibly go wrong that day.
